DESCRIPTION: A Sennheiser Spectera base station over the Sound Control Protocol, version 2, HTTPS on 443: its packs - name, state, battery, RF, mute and sleep - its two RF channels, its inputs and outputs, its site and its state, all watched as they change. Its login row holds controlSennheiser and the password set in Control Cockpit; its pin the certificate's fingerprint, trusted once shown.

SOURCES: Sennheiser, Sennheiser Sound Control (SSCv2) Specification, version 2.3 (docs.cloud.sennheiser.com): HTTPS and HTTP/1.1 only, the subscription - GET /api/ssc/state/subscriptions as Server-Sent Events, the open event's sessionUUID, PUT .../{sessionUUID}/add with a JSON array of paths, the initial values reported on add, notifications keyed by resource path - and PUT's partial, transactional updates

Sennheiser, 3rd party API documentation as docs.cloud.sennheiser.com lists it (Spectera OpenAPI 18.1, 07/2026; the instruction manual 08/2025): third-party access off until enabled in Control Cockpit with a password. The OpenAPI file itself was not read - the field names below are to be checked against it, or a base station, at JTSE

cross-read, not copied: bitfocus/companion-module-sennheiser-spectera (MIT; Sennheiser's own), its API client and types: Basic authentication as controlSennheiser, the resource paths it watches, the fields of a pack, an RF channel, the site and the state

warnings.DESCRIPTION: Its warnings now, one a value.

channels.DESCRIPTION: The two RF channels, by rfChannelId.

frequency.DESCRIPTION: The channel's frequency in kHz, in steps of 1000.

txPower.DESCRIPTION: The transmit power in mW: 10, 20, 30, 50 or 100.

bandwidthMode.DESCRIPTION: The bandwidth in kHz: 6000, 8000 or 10000, as the country's licence allows.

frequency.DESCRIPTION: The channel's frequency in kHz, in steps of 1000.

txPower.DESCRIPTION: The transmit power in mW: 10, 20, 30, 50 or 100.

bandwidthMode.DESCRIPTION: The bandwidth in kHz: 6000, 8000 or 10000, as the country's licence allows.

antennas.DESCRIPTION: The antenna ports, by antennaPortId: state, interference.

all.DESCRIPTION: Every paired pack - SEK bodypack or SKM handheld - by the mtUid the base station gave it; its fields: name, type (SEK or SKM), state (Connected, Disconnected, Syncing, Sleeping, Updating), batteryFillLevel (per cent), batteryRuntime (minutes), batteryLow, rssi, micLqi, interference/severity, sleep, identify, micPreampGain, micLowCutHz, headphoneVolume, headphoneBalance, rfChannelId.

inputs.DESCRIPTION: The audio inputs, by inputId: name, inputSource (AoIp, Madi1, Madi2).

outputs.DESCRIPTION: The audio outputs, by outputId: what is routed to each interface.

health.DESCRIPTION: The power supplies and the temperature: psu, tempstateoverall.
